name: XTTSv2 NxD Inference server (DLC, HTTP /synthesize)
description: Run xttsv2_server.py inside an AWS Neuron DLC managed by a systemd unit. The unit invokes `docker run --rm --device /dev/neuron0 ...` against an image built locally on top of public.ecr.aws/neuron/pytorch-inference-neuronx:2.9.0-neuronx-py312-sdk2.28.0-ubuntu24.04 (Dockerfile.server). SDK 2.28 is pinned because newer SDKs hit NCC_IXRO002 on this model. Listens on port {{PORT}} with the TrainiumTtsEngine wire contract (POST /synthesize) plus GET /health. NEURON_RT_VISIBLE_CORES={{NEURON_CORES}} (default 0-3 on trn2.3xlarge; on trn2.48xlarge override to 56-59 to stay clear of Whisper at 48-55 / Qwen3-VL at 32-47 / Qwen-Image-Edit at 0-31).

variables.XTTSV2_REFERENCE_VOICE_TEXT: これはトレーニウム上で動く XTTSv2 のサンプルボイスです。声色は Amazon Polly の日本語音声をクローン元として複製しています。

tasks.name: Verify docker + Neuron device + compiled artefacts + checkpoint
tasks.description: Compiled artefacts must exist (run xttsv2-precompile first). Docker daemon must be active and /dev/neuron0 must be present.
commands: command -v docker >/dev/null || { echo '[NG] docker not installed'; exit 1; }
systemctl is-active docker.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo '[NG] docker.service not active'; exit 1; }
test -f {{COMPILED_MODEL_PATH}}/.compile_metadata.json || { echo '[NG] .compile_metadata.json missing — run xttsv2-precompile.json first'; exit 1; }

tasks.name: Stop existing xttsv2-server.service (if any)
tasks.description: Idempotent: ignore failures and remove any stale container with the same name.

tasks.name: Download + extract xttsv2 server tarball into SERVE_DIR
tasks.description: Fetch source via presigned URL and extract under SERVE_DIR. The tarball carries xttsv2_server.py + neuron_xttsv2/ + Dockerfile.server (which is built locally next).
commands: test -n '{{SOURCE_TARBALL_URL}}' || { echo '[NG] SOURCE_TARBALL_URL is empty'; exit 1; }
test -f {{SERVE_DIR}}/xttsv2_server.py || { echo '[NG] xttsv2_server.py missing after extract'; exit 1; }
test -d {{SERVE_DIR}}/neuron_xttsv2 || { echo '[NG] neuron_xttsv2/ missing after extract'; exit 1; }
test -f {{SERVE_DIR}}/Dockerfile.server || { echo '[NG] Dockerfile.server missing after extract'; exit 1; }

tasks.name: Ensure voice reference dir exists
tasks.description: Create {{XTTSV2_VOICES_DIR}}/{{XTTSV2_DEFAULT_VOICE}} so the server has a place for voice references. Voice cloning uses the wav files placed under that dir; the next step seeds it with a Polly-generated sample so cloning works out-of-the-box.

tasks.name: Seed {{XTTSV2_DEFAULT_VOICE}} with a Polly-generated reference WAV
tasks.description: XTTSv2 is a voice-cloning model — without an on-disk reference it falls back to a built-in English-native speaker, which produces obviously non-native Japanese audio. We synthesise a short Japanese sample with Amazon Polly ({{XTTSV2_REFERENCE_VOICE_ID}}/neural) and convert it to 24 kHz mono WAV so XTTSv2 clones a Japanese-native timbre. Idempotent: skipped when reference.wav already exists. Polly Neural is not yet GA in sa-east-1 so we always call us-east-1 for the synthesise call (configurable via XTTSV2_REFERENCE_VOICE_REGION).
commands: if [ -f "$REF_WAV" ]; then echo '[OK] reference.wav already exists, skip'; exit 0; fi
command -v ffmpeg >/dev/null || { echo '[INFO] installing ffmpeg'; DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq ffmpeg; }

aws polly synthesize-speech --region {{XTTSV2_REFERENCE_VOICE_REGION}} --engine neural --voice-id {{XTTSV2_REFERENCE_VOICE_ID}} --language-code ja-JP --output-format mp3 --text '{{XTTSV2_REFERENCE_VOICE_TEXT}}' "$TMP_MP3" >/dev/null
test -s "$TMP_MP3" || { echo '[NG] Polly produced empty mp3'; exit 1; }
test -s "$REF_WAV" || { echo '[NG] ffmpeg produced empty wav'; exit 1; }

tasks.name: Pull DLC base image if missing
tasks.description: Idempotent docker pull for the DLC layer that Dockerfile.server is built FROM.
commands: if docker image inspect '{{DLC_IMAGE}}' >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '[OK] base image already present'; exit 0; fi

tasks.name: Build the runtime image (DLC + coqui-tts + torchaudio)
tasks.description: Bakes coqui-tts + torchaudio + fastapi into a layer on top of the DLC so that container start is fast and reproducible. Idempotent: skipped if the tag already exists with the right base.
commands: if docker image inspect '{{RUNTIME_IMAGE}}' >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '[OK] runtime image already built'; exit 0; fi

tasks.name: Install xttsv2-server.service systemd unit (docker-managed)
tasks.description: The unit launches the runtime image with `docker run --rm --device /dev/neuron0`. Restart=always covers transient issues. TimeoutStartSec=900 covers warm-up while the model loads ~3GB of NEFF.

tasks.name: daemon-reload + enable + start xttsv2-server
tasks.description: Reload systemd and bring the service up.

tasks.name: Local HTTP health check on 127.0.0.1:{{PORT}}/health
tasks.description: Warm-up loads model weights into NeuronCores; allow up to 600s.
commands: if [ "$code" = "200" ]; then echo "[OK] http=$code (attempt=$i)"; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:{{PORT}}/health; echo; exit 0; fi
echo '[NG] xttsv2-server did not become healthy in 600s' >&2
